Rock Imperium Festival 2027

As the major headliner of this first announcement, Helloween will arrive at Rock Imperium celebrating their 40th anniversary. The most important band in the history of power metal will lead an outstanding first wave of confirmations. Children Of Bodom will pay tribute to Alexi Laiho in their only Spanish show of 2027, with a concert celebrating the greatest classics of the Finnish band. Mayhem, worldwide standard-bearers of black metal. Completing this first round of confirmations is Erik Grönwall, one of the finest voices in international hard rock.

After celebrating the biggest edition alongside Iron Maiden, in 2027 we return.
